method: Launch the unchanged container_command with a UID 10000 private source directory. A disposable setup container prepares ownership only inside the unique disk-backed fixture bind mount.
launch_profile: Unchanged fixed root watchdog, workdir /work/source, capability drop ALL plus SETUID/SETGID/SETPCAP/KILL, followed by UID 10000 with no capabilities.
limitations: Tests the frozen launcher and exact restrictive ownership modes using an ordinary disk-backed directory, without invoking the root prepare method or its ext4 loop mount.
No evidence of installed-VM disk quota, HAOS App operation or cloud coding capability.
